key.label: API key or self-hosted bearer token

access.description: Read only and read and write cover all API areas. Custom lets you choose several areas independently.
access.label: Access

account.description: Profile, API keys, password, two-factor settings and sessions. Write access can issue new account credentials.
account.label: Account

administration.description: Users, global inventory and authentication policies. Requires an Umami administrator.
administration.label: Administration

collection.description: Send analytics, events, identity updates, performance/error data, recordings and heatmaps. Collection writes can target any supplied website ID.
collection.label: Collection

deployment.description: Cloud uses your account's region unless you choose US or EU.
deployment.label: Deployment

host.description: Keep api.umami.is for Umami Cloud. For self-hosting, enter the public HTTPS hostname (optionally :port), without a scheme or path.
host.label: API host

reports.description: Annotations, funnels, goals, segments and cohorts.
reports.label: Reports

teams.description: Teams, membership and their website, board, link and pixel inventories.
teams.label: Teams

description: Analyze website traffic and manage Umami analytics with configurable access to each API area.
name: Umami
